items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Swope was a phenomenal trombone player, he had the same kind of time... Sweets was like that, like a one man rhythm section, that’s what Swope was like.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, I know, I know, but I don’t think there’s anybody that comes close. But he really honed in on what Swope did the best.
Which is what, do you think?
